name: genslm_esm
description: Embed codon (space-separated uppercase codons) or amino-acid sequences with GenSLM-ESM (ESMC-architecture 600M contrastive) on Aurora XPU; returns per-layer hidden states (mean-pooled or per-token) and, optionally, Top-K SAE features for the layer. One row per sequence.

example.sequence: ATG GCT AAA GGT GAA CTG TTC ACC GGT GTT GTG CCC ATC CTG GTC GAG CTG GAC GGC GAC TAA

_doc: Per-skill MCP spec (docs/SKILL_MCP_DESIGN.md §5). A thin 'skills' MCP tool genslm_esm.embed(inputs, defaults) validates each row against row_schema, write_files-stages inputs.jsonl + the runner, and calls loam-hpc run_batch(script_path=runner, inputs_path=jsonl, gpus=1, timeout_each>=1800 for load/IO contention). The runner resolves the venvs/aurora python + model/SAE paths worker-side (site.<system>.json['genslm_esm'] -> defaults), loads the frameworks module in a login shell, and subprocesses an embedded driver (the verified embed_and_sae.py API). device MUST be xpu (a CPU fallback is a failure). For a codon row the SAE at the default best/layer32 matches layer=32; a different layer needs a matching sae_dir.
